  RULE legion-xv-named | Legiones Astartes (Thousand Sons) | hidden=false | This Detachment is Thousand Sons. Models with the Legiones Astartes special rule gain Legiones Astartes (Thousand Sons). Legion-specific rules, units, wargear and characters are unlocked by this selection where applicable.
  RULE r25-legion-xv-reference | Thousand Sons — Legion Rules & Armoury | hidden=false | LEGION SPECIAL RULES SORCERERS OF PROSPERO The Thousand Sons possess an unparalleled concentration of psychic talent amongst the Legiones Astartes, and the study of the Warp permeates every level of the Legion. All Thousand Sons Independent Characters are Psykers. Unless they already possess a higher Psychic Mastery Level, they count as Psyker (Mastery Level 1). A Thousand Sons Praetor instead counts as Psyker (Mastery Level 2). Thousand Sons Psykers may select their psychic powers from the following ProHammer Psychic Disciplines: • Biomancy • Divination • Pyromancy • Telekinesis • Telepathy The number of powers known and which may be invoked is determined by the Psyker's Mastery Level and the normal ProHammer psychic rules. A Thousand Sons Librarian Consul follows these rules normally. Activating a Force Weapon counts as the use of a psychic power. A Psyker may not use the same psychic power more than once during the same player turn. THE PROSPERINE CULTS The warriors of the Thousand Sons were organised according to the great psychic Cults of Prospero, each devoted to the mastery of a particular aspect of the psychic arts. Every Thousand Sons Infantry unit and Independent Character must be assigned to one of the following Prosperine Cults when the army is selected: • Pavoni • Raptora • Corvidae • Athanaeans • Pyrae The chosen Cult must be recorded on the army roster. selectionEntry r25-rite-xv-0-the-axis-of-dissolution | Thousand Sons Rite of War — The Axis Of Dissolution | type=upgrade hidden=false pts=[] cons=max=1 field=selections scope=parent id=r25-rite-xv-0-the-axis-of-dissolution-max
  RULE r25-rite-xv-0-the-axis-of-dissolution-rule | The Axis Of Dissolution | hidden=false | The Axis of Dissolution is a carefully prepared tactical configuration in which the enemy is drawn against positions selected in advance by the Legion's seers, held in place by disciplined resistance and destroyed as the pattern of battle unfolds. EFFECTS THE ALEMBIC OF ADAMANT Thousand Sons units automatically pass Morale and Pinning tests while they have at least one model within 6" of an Objective. If the mission does not use Objective markers, after deployment zones have been determined the Thousand Sons player may nominate one terrain feature outside the enemy deployment zone. The centre of that terrain feature counts as an Objective for the purposes of this rule only. THE CAUSTIC OF GRACE Thousand Sons Infantry units may enter Overwatch even if they moved during their preceding Movement phase, provided they did not Advance. All other ProHammer requirements for entering Overwatch apply normally. THE TRANSITION OF VITRIOL Thousand Sons models may re-roll failed To Hit and To Wound rolls when attacking an enemy unit which is Falling Back. Against Vehicles affected by a mission-specific retreat or withdrawal rule, re-roll failed Armour Penetration rolls instead of failed To Wound rolls. selectionEntry r25-rite-xv-1-the-guard-of-the-crimson-king | Thousand Sons Rite of War — The Guard Of The Crimson King | type=upgrade hidden=false pts=[] cons=max=1 field=selections scope=parent id=r25-rite-xv-1-the-guard-of-the-crimson-king-max
  RULE r25-rite-xv-1-the-guard-of-the-crimson-king-rule | The Guard Of The Crimson King | hidden=false | When the most powerful formations of the XV Legion were committed to battle, the Sekhmet and the Legion's greatest sorcerers could be concentrated into a single overwhelming psychic spearhead. EFFECTS ASTRAL WARFARE The first two psychic powers successfully invoked by Thousand Sons Psykers during each player turn are ignored when determining the penalties caused by Disturbance in the Warp. All other ProHammer psychic rules apply normally. WREATHED IN LIGHTNING, THEY REND THE VEIL All Thousand Sons units composed entirely of models wearing Terminator Armour gain Teleportation Transponders at no additional points cost. Thousand Sons Independent Characters may purchase Teleportation Transponders for +10 points regardless of the armour they wear. Whenever a unit or Character using these Transponders arrives by Deep Strike, it gains the Fear special rule and may re-roll Invulnerable Save rolls of 1 until the beginning of the next Thousand Sons player turn. INITIATES OF THE SCARAB Sekhmet Terminator Cabals may be selected as Troops choices and must fulfil the Detachment's compulsory Troops selections. THE BIDDING OF THE CRIMSON KING Magnus the Red may fulfil a compulsory HQ selection when using this Rite and does not occupy a Lord of War selection. LIMITATIONS The army's Warlord must be Magnus the Red, Ahzek Ahriman or a Thousand Sons Praetor. A Thousand Sons Praetor selected as the

In some formations entire battle companies acted as extensions of their sorcerous commanders, combining Legion discipline with the collective psychic gifts of Prospero. EFFECTS CIRCLES OF INITIATES A Legion Tactical Squad containing 20 models may purchase Brotherhood of Psykers (Mastery Level 1\) for +25 points per squad. A Tactical Squad upgraded in this manner selects one psychic power from the normal Psychic Disciplines available to Thousand Sons Psykers and gains the Cult Mastery benefit of its chosen Prosperine Cult. The unit follows all normal ProHammer rules for Brotherhood of Psykers. FELLOWSHIP VETERANS Legion Veteran Squads and Legion Terminator Squads purchase Brotherhood of Psykers for +15 points per squad instead of the normal +25 points. MAGISTER TEMPLI At the beginning of each Thousand Sons player turn, the Warlord may nominate one friendly Psychic Brotherhood within 12". Until the beginning of the next Thousand Sons player turn, that Brotherhood may use the Warlord's Leadership when taking Psychic Tests. This specifically overrides the normal rule preventing a Psychic Brotherhood from using the Leadership of an attached Independent Character. He receives both the Pavoni Cult Arcana and Cult Mastery benefits. MAGISTER TEMPLI OF THE PAVONI Hathor Maat selects both of his psychic powers from the ProHammer Biomancy discipline. He otherwise follows all normal ProHammer rules for a Mastery Level 2 Psyker. AETHERIC REFRACTOR FIELD Hathor Maat has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. This is already included in his profile. PAVONI VITALIST Hathor Maat has Feel No Pain (5+). While Hathor Maat is joined to a friendly Thousand Sons Infantry unit, that unit also gains Feel No Pain (5+). He receives both the Athanaean Cult Arcana and Cult Mastery benefits. PSYCHIC POWERS Sanakht knows only Mindsong of Blades. He does not select a psychic power from the normal ProHammer Psychic Disciplines. MINDSong OF BLADES Mindsong of Blades is a Blessing invoked at the beginning of an Assault phase. If successfully invoked, until the end of that Assault phase: • models in Sanakht's unit gain +1 Initiative; • models in the unit may re-roll close-combat To Hit rolls of 1. PAIRED PROSPERINE FORCE BLADES Sanakht's blades count as a pair of Prosperine Force Weapons. The bonus Attack for fighting with two close-combat weapons is already included in his profile. Whenever a unit or Character using these Transponders arrives by Deep Strike, it gains the Fear special rule and may re-roll Invulnerable Save rolls of 1 until the beginning of the next Thousand Sons player turn. THE BIDDING OF THE CRIMSON KING Magnus the Red may fulfil a compulsory HQ selection when using this Rite and does not occupy a Lord of War selection. selectionEntry r42-role-xv-crimson-magnus-hq-r41-unit-xv-11-xv-magnus-the-red-the-crimson-king | XV — MAGNUS THE RED, THE CRIMSON KING | type=unit hidden=true pts=[('Points', '550')] cons=max=1 field=selections scope=roster id=r42-role-xv-crimson-magnus-hq-r41-unit-xv-11-xv-magnus-the-red-the-crimson-king-unique
  RULE r42-role-xv-crimson-magnus-hq-r41-unit-xv-11-xv-magnus-the-red-the-crimson-king-source | Source Entry | hidden=false | Primarch of the Thousand Sons, the Crimson King, Lord of Prospero Magnus the Red was the most psychically gifted of the Emperor’s sons, a towering scholar-warrior whose understanding of the immaterium exceeded that of all but the greatest minds of the Imperium. Upon Prospero he gathered philosophers, occultists and psykers into a civilisation devoted to knowledge, while the Thousand Sons themselves became masters of disciplines that other Legions regarded with suspicion and fear. Upon the battlefield Magnus wielded sorcery as naturally as another warrior might wield a blade. He shattered armour with raw aetheric force, twisted the paths of fate, shielded his sons behind impossible barriers and reached into the minds of his enemies. Where lesser psykers risked being overwhelmed by the turbulence of the Warp, the presence of the Crimson King seemed instead to force that turbulence into obedience. === CORE terminator-unit ===
selectionEntry terminator-unit | Legion Terminator Squad | type=unit hidden=false pts=[('Points', '55')] cons=
  RULE terminator-standard | Standard Wargear | hidden=false | Every model is equipped with the selected Terminator Armour pattern, a Combi-bolter and a Power Weapon unless replaced below.
  RULE terminator-legiones | Legiones Astartes | hidden=false | All models have the Legiones Astartes special rule and And They Shall Know No Fear as presented in ProHammer Classic. They are not Fearless.
  RULE terminator-implacable | Implacable Advance | hidden=false | In any mission which distinguishes between Scoring and non-Scoring units, a Legion Terminator Squad counts as a Scoring Unit whenever Troops choices normally count as Scoring Units.
  RULE terminator-transport-rule | Dedicated Transport | hidden=false | The squad may select a Land Raider, a Land Raider variant with sufficient Transport Capacity, a Dreadclaw Drop Pod or a Spartan Assault Tank where permitted. A Dreadclaw can carry only five models in Terminator Armour, so it is selectable here only for a five-model squad. Land Raider and Spartan choices will become selectable when their vehicle entries are added.

selectionEntry breacher-unit | Legion Breacher Siege Squad | type=unit hidden=false pts=[('Points', '50')] cons=
  RULE breacher-standard-wargear | Standard Wargear | hidden=false | Every model is equipped with Hardened Power Armour, a Bolter, a Bolt Pistol, a Boarding Shield and Frag Grenades.
  RULE breacher-legiones | Legiones Astartes | hidden=false | All models have And They Shall Know No Fear as presented in ProHammer Classic and gain the named Legiones Astartes rule of their chosen Legion. They are not Fearless.
